name: @veren/im-hub
description: Use when this DSH device should receive WeChat messages through the cloud im-hub gateway instead of holding an iLink session itself: the plugin long-polls the hub's device API outbound (no inbound port, shared device token), registers the hub provider into the core registry so inbound senders enter the conversation domain through the observed-message event, attaches the cloud people directory, and delivers agent-authored room messages back to the hub by subscribing im/message-new; pair it with the @veren/im-hub app running on the CMS host — one authorized WeChat per owner serves every registered device.
